bundle.shortDescription: See every symbol, call and change in a project, with the evidence for each.
bundle.longDescription: Tracemark indexes a project on your own machine. Browse its symbols and calls, and review changes with fixed rules before you approve them. Every result says how it is known. Nothing is uploaded.
